# The Sports Room

> The Sports Room (TSR) is an independent digital sports media platform covering cricket, football, tennis, Formula 1, basketball, esports, volleyball, and hockey. TSR publishes sports news, match reports, analysis, previews, schedules, rankings, tactical features, and sports-science content.

## Core Navigation & Pages

- [Home](/) - The main portal for the latest sports news, featured stories, match coverage, scores, schedules, and sports analysis.
- [Sports Atlas](/sports-atlas) - Sports-science and educational resources covering biomechanics, performance, tactics, engineering, and technical aspects of sport.
- [Rankings](/rankings) - Sports standings, rankings, points tables, and competition classifications where available.
- [Fixtures](/fixtures) - Upcoming sports fixtures, match schedules, dates, venues, and related event information.
- [About Us](/about-us) - Information about The Sports Room, its mission, editorial focus, and platform.
- [Contact Us](/contact-us) - Contact information for news tips, story submissions, corrections, and general inquiries.

## Sports Coverage

### Cricket

- [/sport/cricket](/sport/cricket) - Cricket news, match reports, previews, analysis, player updates, team news, international cricket, Pakistan cricket, PSL, ICC competitions, and major domestic tournaments.
- Coverage includes Pakistan, India, Australia, England, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Afghanistan, West Indies, and other major cricket teams and competitions.

### Football

- [/sport/football](/sport/football) - Football news, match reports, tactical analysis, competitions, player updates, fixtures, results, UEFA competitions, Premier League coverage, international football, and FIFA World Cup coverage.

### Tennis

- [/sport/tennis](/sport/tennis) - Tennis news, match reports, tournament coverage, ATP and WTA updates, rankings, Grand Slam events, player developments, and tactical analysis.

### Formula 1

- [/sport/f1](/sport/f1) - Formula 1 news, race reports, qualifying results, driver updates, team developments, contracts, technical analysis, aerodynamics, strategy, and pit-stop coverage.

### Basketball

- [/sport/basketball](/sport/basketball) - Basketball news, NBA coverage, standings, results, player updates, draft developments, match analysis, and tactical features.

### Esports

- [/sport/esports](/sport/esports) - Esports news, tournament results, team developments, competitive gaming, standings, player updates, and analysis across major esports titles.

### Volleyball

- [/sport/volleyball](/sport/volleyball) - Volleyball news, match results, tournament coverage, schedules, rankings, player and team updates, and technical analysis.

### Hockey

- [/sport/hockey](/sport/hockey) - Hockey news, match coverage, tournaments, results, player updates, rankings, and tactical and technical analysis.

## Editorial Content

The Sports Room publishes several types of sports content, including:

- News reports
- Breaking sports updates
- Match reports
- Match previews
- Tournament previews
- Player and team news
- Interviews and quotes
- Statistical analysis
- Tactical analysis
- Sports explainers
- Sports-science features
- Competition guides
- Rankings and standings
- Fixtures and schedules

## Article Structure

Sports articles are organized primarily under:

- `/blog/` - Individual sports articles, news reports, analysis, previews, guides, and features.
- `/sport/` - Sport-specific content collections.
- `/topic/` - Topic and entity-based content collections where available.

Individual article pages may contain publication dates, modified dates, authorship information, article categories, related topics, images, and structured metadata.

## News & Current Coverage

The Sports Room covers current developments across international and domestic sports. News articles should be evaluated based on the information and publication date presented on the individual article page.

Recent news content may also be represented in the site's Google News sitemap:

- [/news-sitemap.xml](/news-sitemap.xml)

The main XML sitemap contains the site's indexable URLs:

- [/sitemap.xml](/sitemap.xml)

## Sports Science & Analysis

Sports Atlas provides educational and analytical resources related to:

- Cricket biomechanics
- Batting and bowling mechanics
- Football sprinting and movement
- Tennis footwork and court movement
- Volleyball serving and rotational mechanics
- Hockey drag-flick technique
- Formula 1 aerodynamics
- Ground-effect engineering
- Racing strategy and vehicle performance
- Athletic performance and sports science

## Structured Data

The Sports Room uses structured data where appropriate to help search engines understand its content.

Potential structured data types include:

- `WebSite`
- `Organization`
- `NewsArticle`
- `Article`
- `CollectionPage`
- `BreadcrumbList`
- `SportsActivityLocation`
- `DefinedTermSet`

Structured data should reflect information that is actually visible and available on the corresponding webpage.

## Content Discovery

For a complete list of indexable URLs, use:

- [/sitemap.xml](/sitemap.xml)

For recent news content represented in the Google News sitemap, use:

- [/news-sitemap.xml](/news-sitemap.xml)

For individual sports sections, use the `/sport/` category pages.

For individual articles, use the `/blog/` pages.

## About The Sports Room

The Sports Room is an independent sports media platform focused on delivering accessible sports news, reporting, analysis, statistics, schedules, and educational sports content across multiple disciplines.

The platform covers both Pakistani and international sports and aims to provide readers with a centralized destination for sports information.
